svg.desc: Every hazard with its scene or the reason it has none
svg.text: Figure 2 · Which hazards have a scene
Every hazard record: 6 have a 3D scene, 16 have none and say why, 0 are unaccounted for (test_scenes3d.py requires every hazard to be one or the
other). A scene needs a motion source: a plant run, a search edge case or a SITL run.
sim/scenes3d/scenes.yaml · safety/hazards
HAZ-DCK-001
Rotor start while UAV is retained or a person is at the dock
no scene: Rotor start on the dock needs a dock and rotor model; SITL starts on the ground
HAZ-DCK-002
False retained state releases UAV under motion
HAZ-DCK-003
UAV battery thermal event while charging on the dock
no scene: Battery thermal behaviour on the dock is not modelled
HAZ-DCK-004
Exposure to energised dock charging contacts
no scene: Dock charging and connector electrics are not modelled
HAZ-GSE-001
Fall from height during maintenance on the walker
no scene: Maintenance access equipment and maintainers are not modelled
HAZ-INT-001
UAV launch or recovery outside the safe envelope
HAZ-INT-002
Pilot acts on misleading or stale UAV information
no scene: Misleading or stale UAV data needs a display and pilot model; SITL does not model the pilot
HAZ-MAN-001
Person struck or pinned by the arms or claws
no scene: Arms and claws are not in the plant (no manipulator or person contact model); CL-05 stowed pose is CAD only (cad/README.md)
HAZ-MAN-002
Carried load swings, shifts or drops while walking
no scene: A carried load is not in the plant (no payload, grip or load-swing model); CL-05 carry pose is CAD only (cad/README.md)
HAZ-PIL-001
Unintended leg motion during pilot ingress or egress
no scene: Ingress and egress motion is not in the plant (no pilot or structure contact model)
HAZ-PIL-002
Uncontrolled vertical drop of the cockpit on loss of leg support
HAZ-PIL-003
Fall from height during emergency egress
no scene: Emergency egress through the side hatch is not in the plant (no pilot or descent model)
HAZ-PIL-004
Normal egress blocked when the walker cannot lower
no scene: Blocked egress needs a pilot and egress model; the plant does not model the kneel
HAZ-PIL-005
Fall during normal ingress or egress
no scene: Climbing the ladder and sill is a human task; no person model in the 3D scenes
HAZ-PIL-006
Delayed or unsafe extraction of an incapacitated pilot
no scene: Crew extraction of a pilot is a human task; no person model in the 3D scenes
HAZ-PWR-001
Residual hydraulic pressure during maintenance
no scene: Stored-energy release during maintenance is not modelled
HAZ-PWR-002
Battery thermal runaway near the pilot station
no scene: Battery thermal behaviour is not in the plant (no cell or pack thermal model)
HAZ-PWR-003
Fuel leak and fire at the engine-generator
no scene: Fuel system and fire are not in the plant
HAZ-SAF-001
Protective stop does not reach a safe state
HAZ-WLK-001
Stale or lost feedback causes runaway motion
HAZ-WLK-002
Walker tip-over or fall with pilot aboard
HAZ-WLK-003
Crushing under the pod or legs while kneeling or rising
no scene: Kneel and rise are not in the plant (no lowered posture or person contact model); CL-05 kneel is CAD only (cad/README.md)
Has a scene
No scene yet (reason recorded)

Generated by tools/figures/scenes3d_readme.py from scenes.yaml, the library and the exported scene analysis. The scenes replay synthetic results: a picture of a simulation, not evidence (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: 3D = three-dimensional · CAD = computer-aided design · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · HAZ-nnn = hazard record
(safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · S3-nnn = 3D hazard scene (sim/scenes3d) · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
